    """Out[b, h, i, d] = Σ_j softmax(Q[b,h,i,:]·K[b,h,j,:]/√D) * V[b,h,j,d]"""
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    #   blockIdx.y -> head    (h)
    #   blockIdx.x -> query   (i)
    #   threadIdx.x -> output dim (d)

        for h in tl.thread_binding(0, H, "blockIdx.y"):

                for d in tl.thread_binding(0, D, "threadIdx.x"):
                    # --------------------------------------------------
                    # 1) Compute max score (for numerical stability)
                    # --------------------------------------------------

                            q = tl.Cast("float32", Q[b, h, i, k])
                            kk = tl.Cast("float32", K[b, h, j, k])
                            dot += q * kk
                        score = dot / tl.sqrt(tl.Cast("float32", D))
                        max_score = tl.max(max_score, score)

                    # --------------------------------------------------
                    # 2) Compute denominator of softmax (sum of exp)
                    # --------------------------------------------------
                    sum_exp = tl.float32(0.0)
                    for j in tl.serial(0, S):
                        dot = tl.float32(0.0)
                        for k in tl.serial(0, D):
                            q = tl.Cast("float32", Q[b, h, i, k])
                            kk = tl.Cast("float32", K[b, h, j, k])
                            dot += q * kk
                        score = dot / tl.sqrt(tl.Cast("float32", D))
                        exp_val = tl.exp(score - max_score)
                        sum_exp += exp_val

                    # --------------------------------------------------
                    # 3) Weighted sum with V using softmax probabilities
                    # --------------------------------------------------
                    out_val = tl.float32(0.0)
                    for j in tl.serial(0, S):
                        dot = tl.float32(0.0)
                        for k in tl.serial(0, D):

                            kk = tl.Cast("float32", K[b, h, j, k])
                            dot += q * kk
                        score = dot / tl.sqrt(tl.Cast("float32", D))
                        exp_val = tl.exp(score - max_score)
                        softmax = exp_val / sum_exp
                        v = tl.Cast("float32", V[b, h, j, d])
                        out_val += softmax * v

                    Out[b, h, i, d] = tl.Cast("float16", out_val)

            arch="sm_12.0",

        B, H, S, D = Q.shape

    batch_size = 32
    num_heads = 32
    sequence_length = 512
    embedding_dimension = 1024
    Q = torch.rand(
        batch_size,
        num_heads,
        sequence_length,
        embedding_dimension,
        dtype=torch.float16,
        device="cuda",
    )
    K = torch.rand_like(Q)
    V = torch.rand_like(Q)
    return [Q, K, V]

    return []
